add_rewards_external_no_guard.meaning: addRewards is an external function that performs transfers and state changes without a nonReentrant guard

claim_rewards_external_no_guard.meaning: claimRewards is an external function that performs transfers and state changes without a nonReentrant guard

pending_accounting_increased.meaning: pending-reward accounting has already been increased within addRewards

transfer_from_completed.meaning: the external transferFrom of addRewards has completed

reentrant_entrypoint_invoked.meaning: claimRewards or another entrypoint is invoked while pending-reward accounting is increased and transferFrom has not completed

griefing_occurs.meaning: griefing is enabled by the reentrancy window

assumptions: The malicious token controls execution during the external transferFrom of addRewards.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish whether the reentrant call to claimRewards or other entrypoints is authorized or succeeds; only the exposure of the window is stated.
Report does not define the concrete observable form of griefing beyond the enabling reentrancy window.

limitations: The intent is encoded as absence of a reentrant entrypoint invocation during the window between pending-accounting increase and transferFrom completion; the report does not specify which entrypoints or authorization state apply.
Griefing is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report provides no more specific observable outcome.
